```{r, calculate complexity metrics}

library(Rvcg)
library(habtools)

# === Paths ===
mesh_folder <- "C:/" #insert path to your mesh folder
ply_files <- list.files(mesh_folder, pattern = "\\.ply$", full.names = TRUE)
z
# === Setup containers ===
metrics_list <- list()
log_list <- list()

# === Wrapper to safely compute each metric ===
safe_metric <- function(fn, mesh) {
  tryCatch(fn(mesh), error = function(e) NA)
}

# === Function to process one mesh ===
process_mesh <- function(path) {
  fname <- basename(path)
  cat("Processing:", fname, "\n")

  mesh <- tryCatch({
    vcgImport(path, readcolor = FALSE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    log_list[[fname]] <<- paste("❌ Import failed:", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
  if (is.null(mesh)) return(NULL)

 #  === Run metrics ===
  metrics <- list(
    Convexity   = safe_metric(habtools::convexity, mesh),
    Rugosity    = safe_metric(habtools::rg, mesh),
    Sphericity = safe_metric(habtools::sphericity, mesh),
    FD          = safe_metric(habtools::fd, mesh)
  )
  log_list[[fname]] <<- paste("✅ Metrics calculated (v =", ncol(mesh$vb), ")")
  return(metrics)
}

# === Progress bar ===
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = length(ply_files), style = 3)

for (i in seq_along(ply_files)) {
  f <- ply_files[i]
  name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  metrics <- process_mesh(f)

  if (!is.null(metrics)) {
    metrics_list[[name]] <- metrics
  }

  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}
close(pb)

# === Save results ===
if (length(metrics_list) > 0) {
  df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(metrics_list, function(x) as.data.frame(t(unlist(x)))))
  rownames(df) <- names(metrics_list)

  out_csv <- file.path(mesh_folder, "complexity_metrics.csv")
  write.csv(df, out_csv, row.names = TRUE)
  message("✅ Metrics saved to: ", out_csv)
} else {
  message("⚠️ No valid meshes processed.")
}

# === Save logs ===
log_path <- file.path(mesh_folder, "complexity_metrics.txt")
writeLines(paste(names(log_list), ":", unlist(log_list)), con = log_path)
message("📄 Logs saved to: ", log_path)


```


```{r, diagnostic check for FD between pre-clean and poisson meshes}
# =========================
# Load libraries
# =========================
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# =========================
# Load data
# ========================
df_pre  <- read.csv("E:/Marco_backups/suture_gen/matched_rescaled/single_element/complexity_metrics_new.csv")
df_post <- read.csv("C:/Users/goswamilab/Desktop/Suppl_Mat/data/complete_recast_metrics.csv")

# =========================
# Rename FD columns (adjust if needed)
# =========================
# Assume columns are named: filename, FD
df_pre  <- df_pre  %>% rename(FD_pre = FD)
df_post <- df_post %>% rename(FD_post = FD)

# =========================
# Merge by filename
# =========================
df <- inner_join(df_pre, df_post, by = "filename")

# =========================
# Remove NA safely
# =========================
df <- df %>% filter(!is.na(FD_pre), !is.na(FD_post))

# =========================
# Correlation analysis
# =========================
pearson_r  <- cor(df$FD_pre, df$FD_post, method = "pearson")
spearman_r <- cor(df$FD_pre, df$FD_post, method = "spearman")

cat("Pearson r:", pearson_r, "\n")
cat("Spearman r:", spearman_r, "\n")

# =========================
# Linear regression
# =========================
model <- lm(FD_post ~ FD_pre, data = df)
summary(model)

# =========================
# Plot: scatter + regression line
# =========================
ggplot(df, aes(x = FD_pre, y = FD_post)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "blue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "FD: Pre vs Post Poisson",
    x = "FD (Pre-Poisson)",
    y = "FD (Post-Poisson)"
  )

# =========================
# Residual diagnostics
# =========================
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model)

# =========================
# Differences summary
# =========================
df <- df %>% mutate(diff = FD_post - FD_pre)

cat("\nMean difference:", mean(df$diff), "\n")
cat("SD difference:", sd(df$diff), "\n")
cat("Max abs difference:", max(abs(df$diff)), "\n")
```
